provenance.method: Atomic claims synthesized conservatively from official scientific and technical references. The corpus avoids time-sensitive market statistics and keeps physical accounting distinct from economic or policy valuation.

warnings: A system loss is not destruction of energy; it denotes energy not delivered in the intended useful form within the chosen boundary.
Primary-energy accounting conventions can differ between statistical systems, especially for non-combustible electricity sources.
Technology performance values depend on design and operating conditions; this reference corpus encodes definitions and structural relations rather than universal numeric efficiencies.
Energy policy, prices, emissions accounting and geopolitical supply risk are outside this Kristal unless required to define a technical boundary.
